reimplementation.script:
# Reimplementation from the written methods only.
# Methods: take the average cups sold on sunny days and on cloudy days,
# then report how many percent higher the sunny average is than the cloudy average.
# Open choices made (noted per methods ambiguity):
#   - Percent higher is computed as ((sunny_mean - cloudy_mean) / cloudy_mean) * 100.
#   - Weather labels are matched case-insensitively after stripping whitespace.
import json
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("data/ice_cream.csv")

# Normalize weather labels (standard choice; methods imply two categories)
df["weather"] = df["weather"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

mean_sunny = df.loc[df["weather"] == "sunny", "cups_sold"].mean()
mean_cloudy = df.loc[df["weather"] == "cloudy", "cups_sold"].mean()

pct_more = (mean_sunny - mean_cloudy) / mean_cloudy * 100.0

json.dump({"value": pct_more}, open("reimplementation_result.json", "w"))
